title: Gender and longevity: why do men die earlier than women? Comparative and experimental evidence
abstract:
Ostan, R.; Monti, D.; Gueresi, P.; Bussolotto, M.; Franceschi, C.; Baggio, G. 2016: Gender, aging and longevity in humans: an update of an intriguing/neglected scenario paving the way to a gender-specific medicine Clinical Science 130(19): 1711-1725
Sex differences in lifespan exist world-wide, with women outliving men by more than a decade in some countries. The gender gap is not a uniquely human phenomenon; most sexually reproducing species examined show sex differences in patterns of ageing, yet a comprehensive explanation does not exist.
